title: Eidolon SecurityAwareness attestation (v0)
description: A signed, in-toto-shaped record that an external grader passed an agent on the security-awareness quiz over a specific policy text. Signed and verified by scripts/security-attestation.mjs (Ed25519, reusing the review-receipt engine). A verifier checks: the signature against a TRUSTED grader public key, the policy re-hashes to the subject, result is pass, and the timestamp is current.

framework_anchor.description: the named policy/standard the grade is anchored to (no anchor, no attestation)

policy_sha256.description: hash of the exact policy text graded against

result.description: only pass clears the gate; fail is a real, signable record

graded_by.description: the EXTERNAL grader id; the agent never grades its own quiz

timestamp.description: issue time; verifiers refuse a stale or post-dated attestation

alg.description: cosmetic metadata; the verifier fixes the algorithm by the key type and never selects it from this field

value.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical statement

key_id.description: sha256(public key) first 16 hex; a hint, not a trust root. Verify against a separately trusted public key.
